items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: you did that with Jay Livingston and Ray Evans, guys who were born six weeks apart in 1950.

ctx.x: Exactly. So, he owns that song. He bought the rights to that song. Now if Paul McCartney wanders in, what do you give him? You give him “Linda.” So in any case, Henry Mancini walks in what do you give him? It’s hard to lay in all these tunes on him from his film scores that he thought, “Who knows this?” He even at one point, he’s got his arms crossed and he’s kind of half-smiling at me, what a great guy he was. April 16, 1924, I observe his birthday. In any case, and June 14, 1984, his death. But he said, “Come…
Well I’m not sure, you were talking about what do you give them?
